output.explanation: Implemented all eight B03 edits, preserving the accepted architecture while adding workspace source navigation, background reads, reverse review navigation and separate API/AI execution gates. Binding discovery reads each stored catalog revision's history head without restoring undo history. Sources has 28 nodes, Runtime 36 and Evidence 40; all diagrams fit their scaffold bounds. These establish dependencies for later source visualization and Agent Chat work without portraying those features as implemented. Positions remain null and edges match the batch exactly.
